learningObjectives: Choose appropriate access modifiers for application components.

activities.title: Interface Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a Java interface and its implementation.

content.concept: An interface defines a contract that implementing classes agree to fulfill. A class uses implements to provide the required behavior.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Declares behavior that implementing classes must provide.
Connects CardPayment to the Payment contract.
Provides the implementation of the interface method.

activities.title: Package Organizer
activities.instruction: Organize classes into packages according to their responsibilities.

content.concept: Packages group related classes, provide namespace organization, and help structure larger Java applications. A package declaration appears at the beginning of a Java source file.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Access Modifier Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each modifier with its accessibility behavior.

content.concept: Java provides public, protected, package-private, and private access levels. They control where classes and members can be accessed.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: protected → same package and accessible to subclasses
package-private → accessible within the same package
private → accessible within the declaring class
config.answer: private → accessible within the declaring class

activities.title: Interface Design Selector
activities.instruction: Choose when an interface is an appropriate design choice.

content.concept: Interfaces are useful when unrelated or different concrete classes need to follow the same behavior contract. This supports loose coupling and polymorphic designs.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Different payment classes must all provide pay()
A class needs only one private helper variable
config.answer: Different payment classes must all provide pay()
